name: tr-banking-card-bins
title: Card BIN ranges of Türkiye
description: Domestic card BIN (bank identification number) ranges published by the Interbank Card Center of Türkiye (BKM) through its BIN API: the issuing bank or payment institution, card scheme, product type, level, brand and card number length for every range.

sources.title: BKM BIN API Servisi, Bankalararası Kart Merkezi A.Ş. (data as served by the API on 2026-10-31)
BKM BIN API Servisi tanıtım dokümanı (Ocak 2026): access terms, history, technical details
Retrieved from: guncel-kart-bin-listesi, daily unmodified export of the BKM BIN API, release 2026-10-31 (binlist.json)

fields.name: bin_range_min
fields.description: First BIN of the range, 7 or 8 digits, as a string. To match a card, compare the first N digits of the card number with the range, where N is the number of digits in this field.

fields.name: bin_range_max
fields.description: Last BIN of the range, same number of digits as bin_range_min. Equal to bin_range_min for a single BIN.

fields.name: issuer_code
fields.description: Four-digit TCMB participant code (EFT code) of the issuing institution. For banks it references code in tr-banking-banks; payment and electronic money institutions (codes 08xx, 09xx) are not in that dataset.

fields.name: issuer_name
fields.description: Name of the issuing institution as given by BKM. BKM abbreviates some names (T.GARANTİ BANKASI A.Ş.); use issuer_code to join with tr-banking-banks for the official title.

fields.name: scheme
fields.description: Card scheme, from the first part of the BKM card type: mastercard, visa, troy, amex, unionpay, diners, jcb, or private_label (Özel Logolu).

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product type, from the second part of the BKM card type: credit (Kredi Kartı), debit (Banka Kartı) or prepaid (Ön Ödemeli Kart).

fields.name: level
fields.description: Card level, from the third part of the BKM card type: classic, gold, business, debit, maestro, electron, platinum or domestic (Yurtiçi).

fields.name: card_type_code
fields.description: BKM three-letter card type code (cardTypeCode), e.g. BBA for MasterCard credit classic, TAG for TROY debit. The three fields scheme, product and level are derived from the text that accompanies this code.

fields.name: brand_name
fields.description: Card programme brand (Bonus, World, Maximum, Axess, Paraf, Bankkart, ...). Empty when BKM gives Marka Yok (no brand).

fields.name: brand_code
fields.description: BKM three-digit code of the brand. Empty when brand_name is empty.

fields.name: card_number_length
fields.description: Length of the card number (PAN) for cards in this range: 14 to 19 digits.
